title: Enterprise asks synthesis and value-pyramid quick-scan
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Create a short, repeatable synthesis workflow that Sales/CS can run weekly to aggregate enterprise (non-bug) feature asks, score them by expected customer value + technical cost + compliance risk, and produce a one-page recommendation for PM review. Problem: enterprise asks currently arrive fragmented across account execs, CSMs, and support threads, resulting in duplicate work, mis-scoped asks, and slow response windows. Goal: reduce intake->decision time from ~3+ weeks to 5 business days for initial scoping and prioritization; establish clear thresholds for escalation to the product roadmap or Dedicated/Private services team.

Scope: deliver a) a standardized aggregation template (sheet + Slack intake + short form), b) a 5-metric scoring rubric (Value, Implementation Effort, Strategic Fit, Compliance/Regulatory Risk, Account Momentum), c) an automated roll-up dashboard view (Looker or Sheets) for PMs to review weekly, d) a one-page recommendation artifact for each aggregated bundle, and e) a training doc and 30-minute office hours for CS. This ticket covers design and delivery of the template, rubric, and automation prototype. Follow-on tickets will include full integration with the Intake Hub and Console signals.

Key decisions to make: which metadata fields are required vs optional; numeric ranges and weights for the score; whether to treat Dedicated/Private deployment asks with higher compliance weight; and the SLA for PM first response. Trade-offs: heavier scoring granularity improves decision fidelity but increases CS overhead; simple binary thresholds speed throughput but may mis-rank edge cases. We recommend starting conservative (5 metrics, 1-5 scores) with weight presets and a manual override flow for PMs.

Outputs (this ticket):
- Aggregation template: Google Sheet + CSV export schema
- Short-form intake (Slack modal + CS playbook snippet)
- Scoring rubric doc and a sample scored bundle for two recent accounts
- Small prototype dashboard (Looker or Sheet view) that lists aggregated bundles and top scores
- One-page recommendation template (PDF/Drive)

Acceptance criteria: see acceptance_criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: CS team can submit an aggregated bundle via the short-form template containing at least: account list, feature summary, top use cases, estimated impacted seats, commercial ask (yes/no), and any regulatory notes.
Each bundle is scored across Value, Effort, Strategic Fit, Compliance Risk, and Account Momentum using a 1-5 scale. Scores and weights are visible in the sheet and computed automatically.
PM reviewer can view all open bundles in the prototype dashboard and mark one of: Accept (roadmap candidate), Defer (backlog), Requires more info, Route to Dedicated/Private team.
A sample of two historical asks is re-scored and results match expected prioritization reasoning documented in comments.
CS and Sales run a 30-minute training and submit feedback; feedback incorporated into iteration backlog.
SLA: initial PM triage status set within 5 business days of bundle submission.
tasks: Draft aggregation template and CSV schema
Design scoring rubric and weight presets
Build Slack modal + short-form submission flow (prototype using Zapier/Sheets)
Create dashboard view (Looker/Suite or Sheets) and wire PM review actions
Write one-page recommendation template and sample bundles
Run pilot with 3 CSMs and 2 AEs for two weeks and collect feedback
